clue.text: I hope for the best and make a choice — the first film

parts.note: to opt is to make a choice
I is the Roman numeral for one, the first number
a mist is a thin film, as on glass

explanation.surface: Someone choosing the opening film of a season, hoping it goes well.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone hopeful by nature says 'I hope for the best', which sums up that cheerful outlook.

clue.text: All things considered by the UN health agency left for individual to digest

indicators.note: taking food inside, so the word for individual holds the other letters

parts.note: one means a single individual
taken as written
the World Health Organization is a UN agency

explanation.surface: A UN health body weighs a matter, leaving a person to absorb it.
explanation.walkthrough: The OUTER word is split around the others; 'by' and 'for' are only link words, though 'considered by' reads like part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in general, taking everything into account.

clue.text: Draw into wrongdoing, to a certain extent

indicators.note: only part of the following words is used, the letters sitting within them

explanation.surface: Someone being led into crime, at least partly.
explanation.definitionFit: To tow is to draw or pull along behind.

clue.text: Near lake, in distress

indicators.note: the lake letter goes inside the word for distress

parts.note: misery is great distress
L is the abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: Close to a lake and in trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Near' here means stingy, not close by.
explanation.definitionFit: Near is an old sense meaning mean with money, so stingy.

clue.text: A few shares in agricultural land

definitions.meaning: a small stake held in a company
a small plot of farmland worked by one person or family

explanation.definitionFit: A small holding of shares is a modest stake; a smallholding is a little farm.

clue.text: Cat, excessively retiring, swallows bit of celluloid

indicators.note: one piece takes in the other, as a mouth swallows food
retiring means drawing back, so the word for excessively is read backwards

parts.note: excessively means too
a cel is a single celluloid sheet in hand-drawn animation

explanation.surface: A shy cat gulping down a scrap of old film.
explanation.walkthrough: A cel is a frame of old-style animation, drawn on transparent celluloid.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocelot is a spotted wild cat of the Americas.

clue.text: Against carrying moveable steps as an aid to climbing

indicators.note: the word for against holds the other inside it

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
a ramp is a set of mobile steps for boarding an aircraft

explanation.surface: Opposition to using portable stairs as a climbing help.
explanation.definitionFit: A crampon is a spiked plate fixed to a boot for climbing on ice.

clue.text: Unpredictable person let off gun

parts.note: to loose is to fire or discharge
a cannon is a large gun

explanation.surface: A wild character fires a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose cannon is someone erratic who may cause damage, like a gun broken free on a ship's deck.

clue.text: Beat, with good smack

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them

explanation.surface: Hit someone, with a hearty slap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smack' looks like a blow, but it is a taste or flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack can mean a slight taste or flavour, which is what a tang is.

clue.text: Urbanite has married in brown.

indicators.note: the words before it are placed inside the colour word

parts.note: tan is a light brown
to own something is to have it

explanation.surface: A city dweller who has wed while wearing brown.
explanation.walkthrough: The full stop ends the clue and plays no part.
explanation.definitionFit: A townsman lives in a town or city, which is what an urbanite is.

clue.text: Where, out of the centre, gondola would be out of place

definitions.text: Where, out of the centre, gondola would be out of place

indicators.note: the remaining letters are moved out of their places into a new order
the middle letter of the seven-letter boat word is taken away

explanation.surface: A gondola looks wrong anywhere but its home waters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of the centre' removes D, the middle of GONDOLA, leaving GONOLA, and 'would be out of place' rearranges it. The whole clue also defines: a gondola off the main waterways might sit in a lagoon, like the one at Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: Venice stands in a lagoon, a stretch of water off the centre where a gondola might drift astray.

clue.text: Knowing about America, I ring all my relations

indicators.note: the word for knowing goes around the next letters

parts.note: fly is British slang for shrewd or knowing
a ring is a circle

explanation.surface: A knowing speaker phones every relative in turn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fly' as knowing or sharp is British slang; 'ring' doubles as a telephone call in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The family circle is the group of a person's close relatives.

clue.text: American writer, a pro, alleged an irregularity

indicators.note: an irregularity points to letters set in a non-standard order here

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A professional claims there was something irregular going on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irregularity' (with 'an' as part of the fodder) rearranges A PRO ALLEGED AN; 'alleged' looks like part of the story but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgar Allan Poe was the American author of tales of mystery and horror.

clue.text: A farmer grew worried, seeing: threatening use of biology

indicators.note: worried in the sense of shaken about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A farmer frets over the misuse of science.
explanation.definitionFit: Germ warfare is the deliberate spread of disease organisms as a weapon.

clue.text: Arrangement of sails provided solution to a big murder

indicators.note: a solution dissolves things, so the letters are broken up and remade

explanation.surface: A detective's answer to a major murder case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'solution to' reads as solving a crime but signals the letter shuffle; 'provided' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bermuda rig is a sailing rig with a tall triangular mainsail.

clue.text: Novelist with a strong constitution

definitions.meaning: Thomas ..., English author of Tess of the d'Urbervilles
robust and able to endure hardship

explanation.definitionFit: Thomas Hardy is the novelist; the adjective means robust, able to stand harsh conditions.

clue.text: Fix position of football team at last in league

parts.note: Leyton Orient is a London football club, usually called Orient
taken as written

indicators.note: takes the final letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A football side ends up at the bottom of its league table.
explanation.walkthrough: Leyton Orient is an English league football club from east London, often called simply Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: To orientate something is to fix its position relative to the compass or surroundings.

clue.text: Quasimodo was on, duly ringing the changes

indicators.note: varying the order, as bell-ringers vary the sequence of bells

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Quasimodo, the bell-ringer of Notre-Dame, was duly at work ringing the bells.
explanation.walkthrough: Quasimodo the hunchback suggests bells, but here it is the old name for the Sunday after Easter, from the Latin introit 'Quasi modo geniti'.
explanation.definitionFit: Quasimodo Sunday is the traditional name of the first Sunday after Easter, also called Low Sunday.

clue.text: Jack leaves meeting, oozing smarm

indicators.note: the Jack letter goes away from the word for meeting

parts.note: a junction is a meeting point of roads
J is the abbreviation for jack in cards

explanation.surface: Jack walks out of a meeting full of oily flattery.
explanation.definitionFit: Unction is an exaggerated, oily earnestness, a gushing of insincere charm.

clue.text: Went fossicking around for material

indicators.note: turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: fossicking is Australian for prospecting, so went fossicking means mined

explanation.surface: A prospector rummaged around in search of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Denim is a hard-wearing cotton twill fabric used for jeans.

clue.text: Gathering no energy for activity on the golf course

indicators.note: with no energy, so that letter is removed

parts.note: deriving means gathering or obtaining, as of information
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Picking things up without any energy on the links.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving is hitting long tee shots, a central activity in golf.

clue.text: Restored particle in esoteric diamonds

indicators.note: the particle word is placed inside the following words

parts.note: recondite means obscure or esoteric
an ion is a charged particle
D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games

explanation.surface: A tiny fragment recovered among some mysterious gems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'esoteric' is a definition-sounding word that gives letters here; the definition is 'Restored'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reconditioned has been repaired and restored to working order.

clue.text: Players forbidden to compete, by the sound of it

indicators.note: the word is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: banned means prohibited from taking part

explanation.surface: Sportsmen apparently barred from competing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Players' suggests sport, but here means musicians.
explanation.definitionFit: A band is a group of musicians playing together.

clue.text: Plant, when wrapped round one stake, say, twisted

indicators.note: the word for when is wrapped around the other letters

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: turned back on itself, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a bar is a rod or pole, of which a stake is an example

explanation.surface: A climbing plant coils itself around a single post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisted' makes RABI from I plus BAR. Arabis is a garden plant, also called rock cress.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabis, or rock cress, is a low-growing flowering plant.

clue.text: Dramatist succeeded with frightening story

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies
a chiller is a scary tale

explanation.surface: A playwright made his name with a horror story.
explanation.definitionFit: Friedrich Schiller was a German playwright and poet, author of William Tell.

clue.text: Claptrap bishop rejected in note

indicators.note: the bishop letter is thrown out of the nonsense word

parts.note: blah is empty, pretentious talk
B is the abbreviation for bishop in chess

explanation.surface: Nonsense from a bishop is turned down in a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Lah is the sixth note of the sol-fa scale.

clue.text: Governess expected girl's return

parts.note: something due is expected

indicators.note: return means the girl's name is read backwards

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: The governess was waiting for a young girl to come back.
explanation.definitionFit: A duenna is an older woman acting as chaperone or governess to girls, especially in Spain.

clue.text: Avoid commitment to someone selfish — a prickly creature

parts.note: to hedge is to avoid committing oneself
a hog is a greedy person who takes more than a fair share

explanation.surface: A noncommittal, greedy person is likened to something spiky.
explanation.definitionFit: The hedgehog is a small mammal covered in protective spines.
